headline: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited: Allotment of Securities
sum: Allotment of Securities - Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 7,900 (Seven Thousand Nine Hundred) Fully paid, Secured, Rated, Redeemable, Listed, Senior Bonds in the nature of…
detail: Allotment of Securities - Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 7,900 (Seven Thousand Nine Hundred) Fully paid, Secured, Rated, Redeemable, Listed, Senior Bonds in the nature of Non-Convertible Debentures ( NCDs ) of face value of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) each aggregating to Rs. 79 Crore (Rupees Seventy Nine Crore Only).
